author: 3owj
content: Fixed: write_vault_stems (workspace.rs) and collect_vault_stems (audit.rs) now both prune directories whose names appear in sources_ignore_dirs at any depth in the tree, not just at the top level. collect_vault_stems gained a new ignore_names: &[&str] param; audit_vault passes config.sources_ignore_dirs. New test: collect_vault_stems_respects_ignore_names_at_any_depth. 367 tests pass.
